dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Judging by your looks, you must be a traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Mondstadt truly is a great place for visitors.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Its temperate climate and clean water give birth to the best apples in all of Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Our famous Satisfying Salad has Mondstadt apples in it. Do you want to give it a try?
